# Tests known to fail a first attempt and pass on a `--repeat until-pass:3`
# retry. Read by scripts/check-test-run.sh --allow-retry-file.
#
# Format: one extended regex per line, matched against the whole test name.
# Anything after whitespace is a comment, and so is a line starting with '#'.
#
# Every entry is a bug, not an exemption. Each one points at the doc/TODO.md
# entry that tracks it; fixing a flake means deleting its line here. With the
# repository variable CTEST_STRICT_RETRIES=true, a retry-rescued test that is
# NOT listed fails the "did the work" check step of its CI job.
#
# Strict mode is off by default. Seeded from 54 test jobs across six green
# ci.yml runs on 2026-10-03: 20 of the 54 jobs had at least one retry-rescued
# test, and 9 of the 12 tests below appeared only once. A tail that long means
# unseen flakes would still turn most runs red, so turn strict mode on once
# a week of runs shows nothing new. (beast_server_test, 27 of 200 jobs and the
# biggest single source, is fixed and no longer listed.)
#
# Observed counts are first-attempt failures out of 54 jobs (2026-10-03) unless
# marked /200 (200 jobs across 19 runs, 2026-10-06..07, after the
# ca_cluster_node bootstrap-election fix). See the TODO.md entry
# "Retry-rescued flakes on the allowlist".

chaos_state_machine_safety_test                    1/54
certificate_authority_property_test                1/54
raft_commit_implies_replication_property_test      1/54, see its own TODO entry
ca_test_fixture_unit_test                          1/54
leader_transfer_test                               1/54
multi_raft_driver_agreement_test                   1/54

# Added 2026-10-28 from 78 ci.yml runs (2026-10-24..28): every test that
# needed a retry in two or more jobs and is not fixed yet. Counts are jobs.
# See the TODO.md entry "Re-measured October 28, 2026".
raft_multi_node_property_test                      5 jobs, "no leader" after a disruption round
membership_change_joint_safety_test                4 jobs, truncated_configuration_entry_is_reverted
raft_batched_durable_writes_test                   2 jobs, no leader within 4 s
raft_multi_node_partition_test                     2 jobs
coap_io_wait_mode_test                             2 jobs
http_pre_vote_timeout_now_test                     2 jobs
ca_cluster_node_rpc_tls_test                       2 jobs
multi_raft_node_s3_process_test                    17 jobs, a REAL lost write (1 of ~2000 after a leader SIGKILL), not a timing flake; see TODO.md

# Removed 2026-11-01, root-caused and fixed (see the TODO.md entry
# "Re-measured November 1"): integration_test, simulator_property_test,
# multi_raft_scale_test, raft_multi_node_fixture_test, and the three EDHOC
# repeaters coap_cantcoap_integration_test, coap_cantcoap_interop_test and
# coap_libnyoci_interop_test (one handshake in 256 derived equal OSCORE ids).
